```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```
```{r}
antibiotics <- read_csv("ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
gt(head(antibiotics))
```
Table above represents Rate of Access antibiotics use in all care settings.

```{r}
antibiotics <- read_csv("ukhsa-chart-download.csv")
ggplot(antibiotics, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) + 
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("DID") +
  ggtitle("Access antibiotics over time")

```
